scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Milk, Cheese,
Old Frying Pans,
Pieces of Cake...
Th-that's everything
I need to make lunch for
my friends in the Factory!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
牛奶，
乳酪，
破舊平底鍋，
小蛋糕......
這些就是給工廠裡的朋友做午餐
所需的全部東西了！

scripts.text: Well, I did promise to help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我答應過要幫你的

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我終於能請夥伴們吃一頓豐盛的午餐了！他們一定會很開心！
啊，我真想好好報答你，可實在想不出能送你什麼......

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有了！
不如嚐嚐我的拿手好菜，卡西斯特製土司？
看著簡單，做起來可很考驗手藝。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
給你！
好好享用，可要記住，早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
我該去準備午餐了。
再見，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh...
Oh, I'm so sorry.
I must have confused
you with someone else.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊......
真對不起。
我一定是把你和別人搞混了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
You see, I've been asking
adventurers that have been
passing through to provide
me with food supplies so that
I can make lunch for my friends
that are working in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你看，我一直在請求路過的冒險者為我提供食材，這樣我就能為在艾音布羅克工廠工作的朋友們做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Yes...
So...
Sorry...
To... Bother you.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
是啊......
那個......
對不起......
打擾你了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs if entranced,
Kasis continues to
stare at the Milk, Cheese
Old Frying Pans and Pieces
of Cake that you are carrying.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF卡西斯彷彿著了魔一般，一直盯著你攜帶的牛奶、乳酪、破舊平底鍋和小蛋糕看。^000000

scripts.text: You can have these if you want.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要的話，這些給你吧

scripts.text: Um, why are you staring?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你為什麼一直盯著看？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Really? Is it alright
with you for me to have
all of this Milk, Cheese,
Pieces of Cake and these
Old Frying Pans? Oh, bless
your kind heart, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
真的嗎？你願意把這些牛奶、乳酪、小蛋糕和破舊平底鍋全都給我嗎？啊，冒險者，你真是好心人~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我終於能請夥伴們吃一頓豐盛的午餐了！他們一定會很開心！
啊，我真想好好報答你，可實在想不出能送你什麼......

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有了！
不如嚐嚐我的拿手好菜，卡西斯特製土司？
看著簡單，做起來可很考驗手藝。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
給你！
好好享用，可要記住，早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
我該去準備午餐了。
再見，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh, let me apologize
again. But I can't help
but admire the quality of
your goods. Er, you know,
the food you're carrying. I'm
a chef by trade, after all.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊，真是對不起。可你帶的這些東西品質真好，我實在忍不住多看兩眼。呃，我是說那些食物。畢竟我可是個廚師。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm sorry, but we're closed
right now. Unfortunately, we
don't have any more bread
in stock. ^333333*Siiiiiiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
抱歉，現在不營業。
麵包已經賣完了。^333333*唉......*^000000

scripts.text: Is something wrong?
scripts.translation: 出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Well, my current contract
with the company that's been
providing me with ingredients
has expired. Of course, it's
bad enough that I don't have
the food to run this business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
給我供應食材的那家公司，合同已經到期了。
店裡沒了食材，做不了生意，就已經夠糟心的了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
But I also feel like I'm
letting my friends down.
You see, I've been sending
them lunch every day since
they've been working in the
Factory over in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
可更讓我難受的是，好像辜負了那些朋友。
自從他們去艾音布羅克的工廠幹活，我每天都會給他們送午餐。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm unable to make
lunch for them at the
moment, but I really want to
help my buddies, especially
since their financial situation
seems pretty bad right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我現在無法為他們做午餐了，但我真的很想幫助我的夥伴們，特別是他們現在的經濟狀況似乎很糟糕。

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text: I'm so sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 真讓人難過

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Sure, I'm willing to accept
help from wherever I can find
it. If you would, I'd like you to bring me some food supplies
that I can use to make lunches
for my friends at the Factory.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
好啊，有人願意幫忙，我當然求之不得。能不能請你帶些食材來，好讓我給工廠裡的朋友做午餐？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Would you
please get me
^4D4DFF50 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Cheese^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Pieces of Cake^000000 and
^4D4DFF50 Old Frying Pans^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
能幫我弄來這些東西嗎？
^4D4DFF50瓶牛奶^000000，
^4D4DFF50塊乳酪^000000，
^4D4DFF50個小蛋糕^000000，
以及^4D4DFF50個破舊平底鍋^000000？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'd really appreciate
your help. My friends seem
so depressed to be working
in the Factory and I want to
do all I can to cheer them up.
Thanks for your kind offer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
有你幫忙，真是太好了。
朋友們在工廠裡似乎乾得很不開心，我想盡量讓他們高興一點。
謝謝你願意幫忙~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm trying to renew
my contract with the
company that's been
providing me with food
supplies, but it hasn't
been working out so far...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我正在和一直為我供應食材的公司商量續約，可到現在還沒談妥......

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I don't know what's
happening, but hopefully
I can find a new supplier
soon. There are my friends
to worry about, as well as
the sake of my business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
也不知道怎麼回事，但願能儘快找到新供應商。
朋友們讓我放心不下，店裡的生意也得顧著。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Anyway, please come
again. Hopefully, we'll
have some good bread
in stock next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
總之，下次再來吧。
希望到時店裡又有好吃的麵包了，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Wait! Don't say
anything! You must be
an adventurer from the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
So... I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的傢伙]
等等！先別說話！你一定是盧恩·米德加茲王國來的冒險者！所以......我猜對了吧？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: How did you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道的？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Allow me to
introduce myself.
My name is Morris Poe,
detective of great acclaim
and world wide fame.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
容我自我介紹。
我叫莫里斯·坡，是一位名揚四海、備受讚譽的大偵探。

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我從未聽說過你

scripts.text: You're kidding me.
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧

scripts.text: I'm outta here.
scripts.translation: 我要走了

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Morris Poe?
Renown detective?
Advocate for justice in
the Schwarzwald Republic?
Surely you recognize one
of my esteemed titles.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
莫里斯·坡？
聲名遠播的大偵探？
修瓦爾茲共和國的正義使者？
這些響噹噹的名號，你總該聽過一個吧。

scripts.text: Nope, I don't know you.
scripts.translation: 不，我不認識你

scripts.text: You're Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 你是莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You don't...?
But I'm a famous hero.
Children look up to me
and wish they'd grow
up to be as smart as me.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
沒聽過......？
不可能，我可是大英雄。孩子們都崇拜我，盼著長大後能像我一樣聰明。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I don't get it.
I'm famouser than
that. A household name
even. I've got a sterling
public image, how could
you never have heard of me...?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
真搞不懂。
我可比那有名多了，簡直家喻戶曉。形象又這麼光輝，你怎麼可能沒聽說過我......？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Kidding? Ha ha!
Look at these keen,
deductive and deeply
analytical eyes and
tell me I'm joking.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
開玩笑？哈哈！
看看我這雙敏銳、善於推理又洞察一切的眼睛，再說我是不是在開玩笑。

scripts.text: Whoa, those ARE keen eyes.
scripts.translation: 哇，那確實是雙敏銳的眼睛

scripts.text: Okay. You're joking.
scripts.translation: 好吧。你在開玩笑

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, this sharp,
penetrating, yet
highly intelligent gaze
belongs to the world
detective and crime
fighter, Morris Poe!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
沒錯，這銳利、透徹又充滿智慧的目光，正屬於世界名偵探、罪惡剋星莫里斯·坡！

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我從未聽說過你

scripts.text: Golly, Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Never heard of...?
Impossible! If there are
two things I hate more
than crime, they would be
dishonesty... And rejection
from beautiful women.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
沒聽說過......？
不可能！要說有什麼比犯罪更讓我厭惡，那就是欺騙......還有被漂亮姑娘拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
When you get over your
sense of pride and gain
a little maturity, then we
might share an actual
conversation. Until then,
you'll just have to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等你放下那點自尊，變得成熟些，咱們也許才能好好談一談。
在那之前，你還是先學著長大吧。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahahahahaah--Huh.
If there are two things
I hate more than criminals,
they would be sarcasm...
And receiving fake phone
numbers from really cute girls.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈哈哈哈——哼。
要說有什麼比罪犯更讓我厭惡，那就是挖苦......還有可愛姑娘給我假電話號碼。

scripts.text: Yeah, you're no Don Juan.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你可不是唐·璜

scripts.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wah...!
Did you just--?!
Ugh, you're the worst
type of person, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哇......！
你剛才——？！
嘖，你知道嗎？你真是最討人厭的那種人！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I think it's too late to
apologize. Why would you
treat someone of my stature
with such caustic sarcasm?!
What excuse could possibly
exonerate your behavior?!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
現在道歉恐怕太晚了。你怎麼能如此尖刻地諷刺我這樣的大人物？！到底有什麼理由能替你的行為開脫？！

scripts.text: I... I was intimidated...
It's how I treat all losers.
scripts.translation: 這就是我對所有失敗者的態度

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course: intense feelings
of awe and fear of my vast
intellect would result in that
kind of deviant behavior. I'll
have to forgive you, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
原來如此，被我的過人才智震懾，心生敬畏和恐懼，才會舉止反常。
看來我也只能原諒你了。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?!
Morris Poe, a loser?
Such defamatory remarks
cannot be forgiven, no
matter how unfounded
and groundless they are!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什麼......？！
莫里斯·坡是個失敗者？
這種誹謗不管多麼毫無根據，我都絕不原諒！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha, oh, that's
funny. Wait. You're...
You're really leaving.
N-no, come baaaack!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈哈，真會開玩笑。
等等，你...你真要走？
別、別走，回來呀！

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
How did I know?
Elementary, my friend.
There was an abundance
of clues for me to make
that sort of simple deduction.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的傢伙]
怎麼知道的？
小意思，我的朋友。線索多得很，做出這種簡單的推理易如反掌。

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Hello...?
...............
Oh, this is embarassing.
I can't believe I'm getting
the silent treatment...

[Morris]
Yes, I know it's
difficult to believe that
you would be fortunate
enough to stand in the
presence of genius. Now,
you must be wondering...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
沒錯，能有幸站在天才面前，確實令人難以置信。現在，你一定在想......

scripts.text: Um, wondering what?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在想什麼？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You're wondering,
"How in the world
can I be as brilliant
as Morris Poe, the
genius detective?"
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你在想：“我怎麼才能像天才偵探莫里斯·坡一樣聰明？”

scripts.text:
[Morris]
First, I think it's fair
to let you know that it's
an impossible dream. Men like
myself only arise in this world
perhaps once every generation.
I'm sorry, but don't give up!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
首先，我得坦白告訴你：這是不可能實現的夢想。像我這樣的人，一代人裡也許才出一個。真遺憾，不過別灰心！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, you can try to reach
a level of intelligence that
is comparable to my own by
joining the Young Detective's
Club. To become a member, you just need one essential article.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
不過，你可以加入少年偵探社，努力讓自己的智力接近我。想成為社員，只需要一樣必備物品。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, you will need the
^0000FFRenown Detective's Cap^000000!
Luckily, I'm giving them
away for a relatively small
material cost, but you must
hurry while supplies last.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，你需要^0000FF偵探之帽^000000！
幸運的是，我只收取相對低廉的材料費，但你要抓緊，數量有限。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Simply bring me
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
But first, let me warn you
not to bring a ^FF0000slotted Bucket
Hat with a card compounded to
it, or any upgraded Bucket Hats. I'm not responsible for any
loss resulting from that.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
不過先提醒你，別拿^FF0000插過卡或精煉過的帶孔軟呢帽來。
因此造成的損失，我概不負責。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hurry and bring me
those items! There are
only 20,000,000 Renown
Detective Caps left!
Once they're gone,
they'll be extinct!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
快把那些物品帶給我！
只剩下20,000,000頂偵探之帽了！
一旦賣完，就絕版了！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
So, did you want to
buy, er, receive this
Renown Detective's Cap
and become an honored
member of the Young
Detective's Club?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
那麼，你是想購買，呃，領取這頂偵探之帽，併成為少年偵探社的榮譽成員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
記住，^FF0000別拿精煉過或插過卡的帶孔軟呢帽來，否則精煉效果和卡片都會損失^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, if you have only
1 Bucket Hat, we can begin.
Young Detective's Club... Salute!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，只要你身上只有1頂軟呢帽，我們就可以開始了。
少年偵探社......敬禮！

scripts.text: Salute.
scripts.translation: 敬禮

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 隨便吧...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, done like a pro!
Now, I need to check your
fee--I mean qualifications.
Let's see now, I need to
look through your Inventory...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，真有模有樣！
接下來我得檢查你的費用——我是說資格。嗯，讓我看看你的物品欄......

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wait. You don't have
enough Magnifiers. You
do want to join this club,
don't you? Did you need to
hear the requirements again?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等等。你的放大鏡不夠。
你是想加入這個社團的，對吧？需要我再說一遍要求嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇不足，確認。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇...確認。
嗯，少了帶孔軟呢帽。
明明就差一點了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇...確認。
帶孔軟呢帽，有了。
喂，Zeny呢？！
那可是最重要的...呃，資格！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 You need
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
Now, remember everything
that you need this time, okay?
I'll be waiting to welcome
you into the elite ranks of 
the Young Detective's Club.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
現在，這次記住你需要的所有東西，好嗎？
我會在這裡等待，歡迎你加入少年偵探社的精英行列。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇......確認。
帶孔軟呢帽，有了。
還——有Zeny。嘿嘿，完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, that's everything!
Welcome to the club! Here's
your Renown Detective's Cap,
so wear it with pride as you
take an active part in our club's
activities and promotion!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好，都齊了！
歡迎入社！這是你的偵探之帽。要自豪地戴上它，積極參加社團活動併為本社宣傳！

scripts.text: Wait, promotion?
scripts.translation: 等等，宣傳？

scripts.text: Hooray!
scripts.translation: 萬歲！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course, isn't it obvious?
As a member, one of your duties
will be to sing accolades of this club so that more members
will join and earn their own
Renown Detective's Caps.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
當然，這還用說？
社員的職責之一，就是大力誇讚本社，讓更多人加入，也擁有自己的偵探之帽。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友們炫耀一下你那頂嶄新、瀟灑又帥氣的偵探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友們炫耀一下你那頂嶄新、瀟灑又帥氣的偵探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Huh. You just failed
the "Test of Respect."
You don't deserve the
honor of wearing the
Renowned Detective's Cap!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哼，你沒通過“尊重測試”。
你不配戴上這頂名偵探之帽！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Have you come to me
in order to obtain another
Renown Detective's Cap?
I realize that such a stylish
headgear is in high demand.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你是來找我再獲取一頂偵探之帽的嗎？
我知道這種時尚的頭飾非常搶手。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
記住，^FF0000別拿精煉過或插過卡的帶孔軟呢帽來，否則精煉效果和卡片都會損失^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
As a proud member of
the Young Detective's Club,
did you bring everything
you need in order to earn
a Renown Detective's Cap?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
作為少年偵探社自豪的一員，你帶齊了獲得偵探之帽所需的所有東西了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not sure~
scripts.translation: 我不太確定~

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?! Every good
detective must have a
photographic memory
and be able to recall
minute details in order
to crack the case.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什麼......？！優秀的偵探都該過目不忘，連細枝末節也記得清清楚楚，這樣才能破案。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Great!
Now let me just
check to see if you
brought everything...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！
現在讓我檢查一下你是否帶齊了所有東西......

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hmm, you don't have
enough Magnifiers? But
those are essential tools
for sleuthing. Come now,
hurry back with them!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
嗯，你的放大鏡不夠嗎？但那是偵探必不可少的工具。
快去吧，趕緊把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇不足，確認。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇...確認。
嗯，少了帶孔軟呢帽。
明明就差一點了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇...確認。
帶孔軟呢帽，有了。
喂，Zeny呢？！
那可是最重要的...呃，資格！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡，確認。
流蘇......確認。
帶孔軟呢帽，有了。
還——有Zeny。嘿嘿，完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great! You've just qualified
to own yet another Renowned
Detective's Cap. Congratulations! Now, let me collect all of these
goods and zeny from you...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！你剛剛獲得了擁有另一頂偵探之帽的資格。
恭喜！現在，讓我把這些物品和Zeny收起來...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha! It's what
I expect from one of
our Junior Gold Members!
How does it feel like to be
the cream of the cream of
the crop? Great, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈哈！
不愧是我們的初級黃金會員！當上精英中的精英，感覺如何？很棒吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, ma'am!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，女士！
那個，能請你幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, mister!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，先生！
那個，能請你幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh! You brought me
some Royal Jelly to
eat, as well as everything
I need to make a Baby Pacifier.
Okay, let me get started on that right away. Just a moment...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦！你帶來了給我吃的蜂王漿，也帶齊了製作嬰兒奶嘴的材料。好，我馬上動手，請稍等......

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Damn.
That Royal Jelly
was frickin' delicious!
Now I can make your
Baby Pacifier. Let's see
here. Ah, here we go...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哇，這蜂王漿真好吃！
現在我可以給你做嬰兒奶嘴了。讓我瞧瞧......啊，做好了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's done!
Now, you're the
proud owner of your
very own Baby Pacifier!
I hope you're happy with
yourself. Travel safe, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
做好了！現在你有自己的嬰兒奶嘴啦！希望你喜歡。路上小心，好嗎？

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text: Sorry, kid...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，小傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Well, my mom has been
sick recently, so both of
us haven't been able to eat
for the past few days. But
if she doesn't eat, how does
she expect to get better?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我媽媽最近生病了，所以我們好幾天都沒吃東西了。
但如果她不吃東西，怎麼能好起來呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So I guess what I'm
asking is, would you be
able to spare some food?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
所以我想問的是，你能分我一點食物嗎？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 幫助他

scripts.text: Refuse to help.
scripts.translation: 拒絕幫助

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you would, do you think
you can get some Royal Jelly
that I can give to my mom? The old lady next door says that it's
really nutritious and helps you get better faster if you're sick.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你能幫我弄點蜂王漿嗎？我想給媽媽吃。隔壁的老太太說，蜂王漿很有營養，生病時吃了能好得快一些。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
My mom would be mad
at me if she found out
I was begging for it, but
Royal Jelly is too expensive
for me to get without any help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
要是媽媽知道我在求人幫忙，肯定會生氣。可是蜂王漿太貴了，我根本買不起！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, would it be alright
if I have this Royal Jelly?
It would really help my mom
feel better. Thanks so much~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，我可以收下這份蜂王漿嗎？媽媽吃了肯定會好受些。太謝謝你了~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, to pay you back, why
don't I make a Baby Pacifier
for you? I learned how to make
one when my baby brother was
born. But first, I'll need some
materials to put it together...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，為了報答你，我為你做一個小孩奶嘴吧？
我弟弟出生時，我學會了怎麼做。
不過首先，我需要一些材料來組裝它...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Would you
please bring
^3131FF1 Nursing Bottle^000000,
^3131FF1 Nose Ring^000000 and
^3131FF1 Pacifier^000000? Oh, and one
more ^3131FFRoyal Jelly^000000 for me~

[Kid]
Oh... Um, that's
alright. Maybe I was
asking too much from
you. I mean, it's true
that you barely know me...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...嗯，沒關係。也許是我要求太多了。
畢竟，你幾乎不認識我...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Th-that's okay.
I guess you must
be so busy that you
don't even have the
time to listen to some
little boy's problems...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
沒、沒關係。
你肯定特別忙，連聽小孩子訴苦的時間都沒有...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, hello, what's this?
You're carrying 1 Black
Dyestuffs, 1 Frozen Rose,
999 Tiger Panties and even
50,000 zeny with you. That's
enough to make a Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，你好！你帶著1個黑色染料、1朵冰雕玫瑰、999條老虎內褲，甚至還有50,000 Zeny。這些材料足夠做一頂時尚防寒帽了......

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Um, would you mind letting
me have those items so that
I can make a Winter Hat?
I'd never be able to gather
those things on my own...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
嗯，你介意把這些材料給我嗎？
這樣我就能做一頂時尚防寒帽了。
我自己根本湊不齊這些東西...

scripts.text: Let her have the items.
scripts.translation: 把材料給她

scripts.text: Don't give her the items.
scripts.translation: 不給材料

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I've always wanted to make
this hat and try it on, even
if it's just once. But don't
worry, I'll give it to you~
Now please next; a moment...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
啊，太感謝了！我一直想親手做一頂，哪怕只戴一次也好。放心，做好後會送給你~請稍等片刻......

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Let's see...
I've got to fold
the rose like this...
Be careful with the dye...
Where did I put all those
pan--Oh, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
讓我想想......
玫瑰要這樣折......
小心別弄到染料......
那些內褲放哪兒了......哦，在這兒。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Finally, it's done!
Now, if you don't mind,
let me try this hat on
for just a little while.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^333333*呼！*^000000
終於做好了！
如果你不介意，就讓我戴一小會兒吧。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Ahhhhhh~
It just feels...
I felt so free~
It was everything
I imagined it to be.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
啊......~
這感覺......
好自由啊~
就和我想像的一模一樣。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Here, please take
this Winter Hat. I really
hope that you'll enjoy it
as much as I do. Well then,
be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
請收下這頂時尚防寒帽。
我真的希望你能像我一樣喜歡它。
那麼，旅途平安，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
I'm sorry, I know that
I was asking a pretty big
favor from someone I just
met. I hope you understand
how much I really want to
make that Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
抱歉，才剛認識，就求你幫這麼大的忙。
但願你能明白，我實在太想做一頂時尚防寒帽了...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Look at that blue
sky. Don't you wish
you could just soar
through the heavens
with your own wings?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
看那片藍天。
你不希望能長出翅膀，在天空中翱翔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Of course, it's an
impossible dream,
but with this Winter Hat,
you can at least enjoy the
sensation of freedom that
a bird in flight must feel.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
當然，這是一個不可能的夢想，但戴上這頂時尚防寒帽，你至少能感受到鳥兒飛翔時那種自由的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
If you would like
a hat like this, I would
need to have some items
that I don't think I can ever
obtain on my very own.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
如果你也想要一頂，就得準備一些材料。
那些東西，我自己恐怕永遠也湊不齊。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^FF00001 Black Dyestuffs^000000,
^FF0000999 Tiger Panties^000000,
^FF00001 Frozen Rose^000000 and
^FF000050,000 zeny^000000. If you can
bring those to me, I shall
make you a Winter Hat.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^FF00001個黑色染料^000000，
^FF0000999條老虎內褲^000000，
^FF00001朵冰雕玫瑰^000000，
以及^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000。
把這些帶來，我就給你做一頂時尚防寒帽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The white rose, in its
purity and simplicity, is
like a woman who doesn't
need jewels or fancy dresses
to look noble and beautiful. It's the perfect gift for a lady.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
白玫瑰以其純潔與簡約，宛如一位無需珠寶或華服便能顯得高貴美麗的淑女。
它是送給女士的完美禮物。

scripts.text: Make a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation: 製作水靈玫瑰

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Ah, I see that you've brought
what I need to bleach the blood
red hue from these Witherless
Roses and adorn these flowers
with eternal elegance. May I use these items to make a Mystic Rose?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
啊，看來您帶來了所需材料，可以洗去這些不凋謝玫瑰上的血紅色，並賦予花朵永恆的優雅。可以開始製作水靈玫瑰了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Thank you. Please
next; a moment while
I concentrate in order to
preserve the natural beauty
of these gorgeous flowers...
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
謝謝。請稍等片刻，我要集中精神，好好保留這些美麗花朵的天然姿態......

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The rose truly is the
undisputed queen of all
flowers. All other flora must
humbly bow to its regal beauty.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
玫瑰是當之無愧的百花之王。
其他花卉在它高貴的美面前，都只能俯首稱臣。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
There, it is finished.
Please remember to wear
your hair in an elegant and
refined manner when wearing
the Mystic Rose so as not to disgrace these beautiful flowers.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
好了，完成了。
佩戴水靈玫瑰時，別忘了將頭髮梳理得優雅精緻，才不辜負這些美麗的花朵。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
帶刺的白玫瑰，總讓我忐忑不安。
萬一刺破手指，讓血滴在雪白的花瓣上，該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
I love roses, but it makes
me sad that their beauty
fades far too soon. And so,
I've found a way to preserve
the beauty of the roses, so
that it lasts for all eternity.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
我愛玫瑰，但它們的美麗消逝得太快，這讓我感到悲傷。
因此，我找到了一種方法，可以保留玫瑰的美麗，使其永恆不滅。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Do you love roses as well?
If you like, I can make a
^3131FFMystic Rose^000000 that you can wear
upon your crown. It's not easy
for me to create, but I believe that you would enjoy it greatly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
您也愛玫瑰嗎？
如果您願意，我可以為您製作一朵^3131FF水靈玫瑰^000000，戴在您的髮間。
製作它並不容易，但我相信您會非常喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Please bring me
^3131FF10 2 Carat Diamonds^000000,
^3131FF3 Witherless Roses^000000,
^3131FF1 White Dyestuffs^000000 and
^3131FF50,000 zeny^000000 if you would
like to have a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
想要水靈玫瑰的話，請帶來：
^3131FF10顆2克拉鑽石^000000，
^3131FF3朵永恆玫瑰^000000，
^3131FF1個白色染料^000000，
以及^3131FF50,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
帶刺的白玫瑰，總讓我忐忑不安。
萬一刺破手指，讓血滴在雪白的花瓣上，該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Hmmm...?
What? Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[神情悠閒的女士]
嗯......？
怎麼了？找我有事嗎？

scripts.text: N-Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒...沒什麼

scripts.text: Um, you look so relaxed.
scripts.translation: 那個，您看起來很悠閒

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Huh.
Alright then.
Well, try not to stare
at people so much.
scripts.translation:
[神情悠閒的女士]
哦，那好吧。
不過，別總盯著別人看。

scripts.text:
[Relaxed-Looking Lady]
Really? You are probably
the twentieth person to
tell me that today. Mmm.
That's strange, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[神情悠閒的女士]
是嗎？
你大概是今天第20個這麼說的人了。
嗯，真奇怪，對吧？

scripts.text: I guess.
scripts.translation: 我想是吧

scripts.text: It's not strange at all.
scripts.translation: 一點也不奇怪

scripts.text:

Oh yeah.
What's your name?
That is, if you don't
mind me asking you.
scripts.translation:
[神情悠閒的女士]
哦，對了，你叫什麼名字？
如果你不介意我問的話。

[{0}]
我叫{1}，是一名冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, one of those?
My name is Achiha, nice
to meet you. I don't really
do much of anything.
Just sit. Relax.
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
哦，原來是冒險者啊。
我叫阿千葉，很高興認識你。
我平時沒什麼事做，就坐著，放鬆放鬆。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
I do have a hobby,
though. Once in a while,
I'll sew a hat. Do you think
an adventurer like you would
want to have a hat I made?
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
不過我確實有個愛好。
偶爾我會縫製帽子。
你覺得像你這樣的冒險者，會想要一頂我做的帽子嗎？

scripts.text: Er, I dunno.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不知道

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Mm. I mean, the
Red Bonnets I make
might not be sturdy
enough for battles.
But what about those
fish and cake hats?
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
嗯，我是說，我做的紅色無邊軟帽，可能不夠結實，不適合打仗。
可那些魚形帽子、蛋糕帽子又怎麼算呢？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Hats...?
That look like
fish or cake? Mm.
Haha. I just got it.
That's, that's funny.
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
帽子......？
長得像魚或蛋糕的帽子？嗯......哈哈，我懂了。真、真好笑。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Really? Well, I can sew
together a ^0000FFRed Bonnet^000000.
It reminds most people
of a baby's bonnet, but
it does look good on
most people I know.
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
真的嗎？
那我可以縫一頂^0000FF紅色無邊軟帽^000000。
很多人覺得它像嬰兒帽，不過我認識的人戴起來，大都挺好看的。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Um, did you want me
to make you one? I can
go ahead and do it if you
bring me some materials.
Since it's just for fun,
I won't ask for too much.
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
嗯，你想讓我給你做一頂嗎？
如果你帶些材料來，我可以開始做。
既然只是玩玩，我不會要求太多。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Just bring
^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and
^0000FF50,000 zeny^000000.

[Achiha]
I think I'm going
to just sit and relax
a little bit longer. But
if you want me to make
a hat for you, come back
with those materials, okay?
scripts.translation:

我想再坐一會兒，放鬆放鬆。
如果想讓我做帽子，就帶著這些材料回來吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, hello.
Isn't it such a nice,
quiet, pleasant day?
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
哦，你好。
今天天氣真好，安靜又舒適，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Indeed.
scripts.translation: 確實

scripts.text: Would you please make a hat for me?
scripts.translation: 請給我做一頂帽子好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Yeah. Today would
be a nice day for a
picnic or a long stroll.
But all I want to do is
just sit and relax...
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
是啊，今天很適合野餐，或者出去慢慢散步。
不過，我只想坐著，歇一歇...

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
What are you talking
about? Oh, you mean the
Red Bonnet? Well, I guess
I can make one. But I think
I need some materials first.
scripts.translation:
[阿千葉]
你說什麼？
哦，紅色無邊軟帽啊？
可以做一頂，不過得先有材料才行。

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
^0000FF1 Green Lace^000000,
^0000FF1 Silk Ribbon^000000,
^0000FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000,
^0000FF1 Sunday Hat^000000 and
^0000FF50,000 zeny^000000.

[Achiha]
Oh, but I don't
feel like making it
right now. I'm soooo
tired. Let me just sit,
relax, even if it's just
a little while longer...
scripts.translation:

不過，現在不太想做。
我好累啊，就讓我再坐著歇一會兒...一小會兒就好...

scripts.text:
[Achiha]
Oh, good, you're here.
I've been waiting for you.
Did you bring everything that
you need to make a ^0000FFRed Bonnet^000000?
scripts.translation:

哦，太好了，你來了。
我一直在等你。
你帶來製作^0000FF紅色無邊軟帽^000000所需的所有東西了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.translation:

嗯，讓我看看。

I hope you like it~
I think I'll relax now...

好了，做完了。

希望你喜歡~

I hope you will enjoy the hat~

希望你能喜歡這頂帽子~

哦，你真的忘了？

[Zealotus]
Kneel, worm!
As ruler of this
Underground Prison,
I command all who step
into my private realm!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
跪下，螻蟻！
我是這座地下監獄的統治者，凡踏入我的領地者，都得聽我號令！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Resist, and you shall be
punished! Grovel and kiss
my feet, and perhaps you
might be spared. Hohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
膽敢反抗，就等著受罰！趴下親吻我的腳，也許還能饒你一命。呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text: Oh, your highness!
scripts.translation: 哦，殿下！

scripts.text: Whatever.
scripts.translation: 隨便吧

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
The submissive woman is
nothing but an ideal dream
for the arrogant male! A true
woman revels in her power to
have her man do her bidding!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
順從的女性不過是傲慢男性的理想幻夢！
真正的女性會享受讓男人聽命於己的力量！

scripts.text: Yes, it's so true!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，太對了！

scripts.text: Boooo!

[Zealotus]
However, in my lust for power, I may have inadventently crushed
the spirits of my beloved a little too harshly. His pride crumbled,
my man even cowers in front of the humans! It pains me to see it.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
不過，我或許是太渴望權力，一不小心把心愛之人的意志摧殘得太狠了。他的自尊徹底崩潰，如今竟連人類都怕！看著真讓我心痛。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
It is beneath me to ask
this of you, but it will take
a human like you to make
him remember who he truly is,
a proud creature of darkness
who should fear only me!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
向你開口有失身份，可只有你這樣的人類，才能讓他記起自己的本性。
他可是驕傲的黑暗生物，本來只該畏懼我一個！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Human. I offer you a small
share of my power if you can
take the pathetic, weeping lump
of monster crying in the corner
of this prison and make him
realize his true nature.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
人類，監獄角落裡有個蜷縮著哭哭啼啼的窩囊魔物。
你若能讓他認清自己的本性，我就分一點力量給你。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
You dirty, dirty human...
How dare you have an 
opinion different than mine!
No matter. The day will come
when all of your race shall
address me only as "queen."
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
骯髒的人類......
竟敢跟我意見相左！
無妨，終有一天，你們全族都得尊稱我為“女王”。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Mortal simpleton!
Bah! The mocking of
a boorish cur is worthless
to me. I have all the time in
the world to grind your pride
to dust beneath my heels.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
愚蠢的凡人！
哼！粗俗之徒的嘲諷對我毫無價值。
我有的是時間，將你的驕傲在我的腳下碾成塵土。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Hm. If my beloved is
acting stubborn or refuses
to listen, feel free to take
drastic measures. Just think
of what I would do in your
place. Ohohohohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
嗯，我的愛人若是犯倔、不肯聽話，就儘管用些狠招。想想換作是我會怎麼做。呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Ooh, you're back.
Phendark is certainly
back to his old self again,
thanks to your efforts, human.
Yes, his anger, his courage
and passion are all restored~
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
哦，回來了。
多虧你出力，芬達克總算恢復了原來的樣子，人類。
他的怒火、勇氣和激情，全都回來了~

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
As I promised, I shall
grant you a share of my
power. However, I will need
some items to form this minor
contract between you and me.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
如我所承諾的，我會分給你一部分力量。不過，我需要一些物品，才能締結你我之間這份小小的契約。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I will need
^3131FF1 Cat's Eye^000000,
^3131FF1 Forbidden Red Candle^000000 and
^3131FF30 Worn-Out Magic Scrolls^000000.
Then, I can grant you a measure
of my power as I've promised.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
我需要：
^3131FF1個貓眼石^000000，
^3131FF1根禁忌紅燭^000000，
以及^3131FF30張舊魔法卷軸^000000。
然後我就能履行承諾，分給你一些力量。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I see that you have
brought what I need to
complete the contract
between you and me,
human. Let's begin...
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
看來你帶來了完成你我之間契約所需的物品，人類。
讓我們開始吧...

scripts.text:
^3355FFZealotus takes the red
candle you've given her and
drips the wax into her open
palm. The Cat's Eye begins
to glow with an eerie light.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF澤洛圖斯接過你給的紅色蠟燭，將蠟滴在攤開的手掌上。貓眼石開始散發出詭異的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Now, place your index
finger into my palm so
that we may complete the
final step of this contract...
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
現在，把食指放在我的掌心，完成契約的最後一步...

scripts.text: Don't complete the contract.
scripts.translation: 不締結契約

scripts.text: Complete the contract.
scripts.translation: 締結契約

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Hm? What are you
afraid of? This is a
minor contract, so
you are not selling me
your soul, or anything
else for that matter.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
嗯？怕什麼？
這只是個小小的契約，又不是要你把靈魂或別的什麼賣給我。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
I, Zealotus, as ruler
of this realm, seal this
eternal contract with this
Forbidden Red Candle.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
我，澤洛圖斯，以此地統治者之名，用這根紅色蠟燭締結永恆的契約。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
{0} will
forever have a share
in my power. Those that
bow to me must also bow
to {1}. It shall be done.

[澤洛圖斯]
{0}將永遠分享我的力量。
那些向我俯首者，也必須向{1}俯首。
就此生效。

scripts.text:

Human, take this
mask with you as an
everlasting token of our
contract. So long as you
carry this, I will be at your
side. So says Zealotus!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
人類，帶上這個面具，作為我們契約的永恆信物。
只要你帶著它，我就會在你身邊。
澤洛圖斯如是說！

scripts.text:

I will need
^3131FF1 Cat's Eye^000000,

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Ah, I greet you in
peace, human. Behold,
the splendor of our realm!
Though, I do not blame you
if you have no interest in
commanding these Injustices...
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
啊，人類，願你平安。
看看我們這片領地，多麼輝煌！
不過，你若沒興趣使喚這些邪惡使者，我也不怪你...

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Thanks to your help,
my Phendark has returned
to his old, monstrously
passionate ways. Now I can
show him the stinging love
of my whip! Hohohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
多虧你幫忙，我的芬達克又恢復了往日那股魔物般的熱情。
這下又能用鞭子，讓他嚐嚐我火辣辣的愛！
呵呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh? Oh no!
Another h-human?!
P-please! S-stay away,
don't come near me!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
什...什麼？！
又...又來人類了？！
求...求你！別靠近我，離我遠點！

don't come near me!
scripts.translation:

什...什麼？！
又...又來人類了？！
求...求你！別靠近我，離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I... I swear!
I'm not carrying any
rare items or stuff you
can wear, so please don't
beat me! I... Oh my god, you
don't believe me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我...我發誓！
我身上沒有稀有物品，也沒有能穿戴的裝備，求你別打我！
我...天哪，你不相信，是不是？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
You humans never leave
me alone! Why do you have
to bully me like this?! I'm
honestly not carrying anything
of value! Z-Zealotus, please!
Zealotus, heeeeeelp me~!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
你們人類從來都不放過我！
為什麼非要這樣欺負我？！
我真的沒帶什麼值錢的東西！
澤...澤洛圖斯，求你了！
澤洛圖斯，救救我~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're pathetic!
Aren't you supposed
to be a monster? You know
what Zealotus would do if
she were actually here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你真丟人！
你不是魔物嗎？
你知道如果澤洛圖斯真的在這裡，她會怎麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
^333333*Sniff...*^000000
P-probably...
Probably whip me.

^3355FFYou nonchalantly^000000
^3355FFbrandish your Whip.^000000

That's right.

^3355FF*Snap!*
*Snap!*
*Crack crack crack!*
*Snap snap snap crack!*^000000

[Phendark]
Oh! That stinging pain
that burns with bloodlust!
It's almost as good as
Zealtos's whip of love!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
哦！這灼熱的刺痛讓嗜血的慾望燃燒起來！
簡直快比得上澤洛圖斯的愛之鞭了！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus...
She must be pissed
at me, but I just can't
stop being afraid of all
you humans! Damn it all!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
澤洛圖斯...
她肯定在生我的氣，但我就是忍不住害怕你們這些人類！
該死啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Y-you again!
Why do you hound me?!
Th-there's nothing I can
give you, so please don't
hurt me! Oh, oh p-please...!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
又...又是你！
你為什麼非要糾纏我？！

什麼......？你想讓我吃這個？

my heart's not in it today, so

chance to run for your life.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Rybio]

been acting really weird
lately. I guess Zealotus
loved him to the point that
she abused him to the point
that he's scared of humans now.

[裡比奧]

scripts.text:
[Rybio]

Dark Crystal Fragments. It's
worthless to humans, but if
creatures of darkness eat it,
it brings out more of their
inner demon. Scary, huh?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
知道什麼能幫上忙嗎？
黑色水晶碎片。
對人類沒什麼用，可黑暗生物吃了，就能激發出更多魔性。
嚇人吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Since Phendark's pretty big, and he's acting like a total wuss, you
you should probably get him to eat ^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000. Don't
worry, you should be able to find those all over Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
芬達克塊頭不小，卻表現得像個膽小鬼。你最好讓他吃下^3131FF369個黑色水晶碎片^000000。別擔心，米德加爾特各地都能找到。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I dunno why a human
like you would want to
help one of us out, though.
What's in it for you, exactly?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
不過，我搞不懂像你這樣的人類為什麼會想幫助我們。
你到底圖什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
That's right!
Run, get outta here!
If you're not fast enough,
I might eat you, human!
...Well... Probably not.

[裡比奧]
沒錯！
快跑，趕緊離開這裡！
如果你跑得不夠快，我可能會吃掉你，人類！
...嗯...大概不會吧。

like you, a seemingly heroic
adventurer, would want to help

[Rybio]

[Rybio]

maybe you could try motivating
him. Reverse psychology?

[裡比奧]

也許試著刺激他一下？
用用激將法？
跟人類商量這些，還真夠怪的。
哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Phendark sure looks
tough, but I guess even
he isn't totally evil. Yeah.
We monsters aren't all
bad... Just mostly bad.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
芬達克看起來很兇悍，不過我想他也不算徹底邪惡。我們魔物不全是壞的......只是大多數都壞。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Oh man...
It's almost lunchtime,
but he hasn't come by
yet. Where could h--Oh!
Hello, welcome to Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
唉...
都快午飯時間了，他怎麼還沒來？
人到底在哪...哦！
你好，歡迎來到艾音布羅克~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Wait a sec, that
Crunch Toast! You must
be the guy who helped out
my buddy, Kasis. I owe you
my gratitude since without your help, I wouldn't eat lunch!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
等一下，那塊土司！你一定就是幫過我朋友卡西斯的人。多虧了你，我才有午飯吃，真是太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]

has been having business
troubles lately, but I'm sure
he'll weather it out. I just don't know what's taking him so long
to get here. I'm sooo hungry!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
聽說卡西斯最近的生意出了些麻煩，不過我相信他一定能挺過去。
就是不知道他怎麼這麼久還不來。
餓死我了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]

heading to Juno? I have
a favor to ask if you're
going there. Or did you
need help finding your
way around this city?

[基裡舒]
請問，你是要去朱諾嗎？如果你要去的話，我有件事想拜託你。
或者你需要我幫你在這座城市裡找路嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm heading to Juno.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我要去朱諾

scripts.text: I need help finding my way around!
scripts.translation: 我需要幫忙找路！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

[Kirishu]

Juno and you're not busy,
would you visit a pastry
chef named Kasis for me?
He's an old friend and I'm
a little worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
如果你要去朱諾而且不忙，能幫我去看看一位叫卡西斯的糕點師嗎？他是我的老朋友，我有點擔心他。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Usually, he sends us
lunches around this time
without fail, but since lunch
hasn't arrived yet, I can't help but wonder, ''What happened?''
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
平時這個點，他肯定已經把午餐送來了，可今天到現在還沒動靜。
我忍不住擔心，是不是出了什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Of course, I'd be lying if
I said my hunger didn't factor
into my concern for his welfare. Anyway, if you have the time,
you can find Kasis in Juno's
Bakery. Thanks, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]

總之，有空就去朱諾的麵包店找找卡西斯吧。
謝謝你，冒險者。

go just outside of the
Airport, you can find
Guides that can tell you
about all the important
places of interest in Einbroch.

[Kirishu]
Now, if you want to take
a rest before or after a
flight on one of the Airships,
you can use the passenger
lounge on the second floor.
It's a good tip to know~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
乘坐飛空艇前後要是想休息，可以去二樓的候機室。記住這個小竅門哦~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Did you have any
other questions to ask
me while you're here?
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
你在這裡還有別的問題要問我嗎？

scripts.text: Can I take a picture with you?
scripts.translation: 能和你合個影嗎？

scripts.text: About Einbroch
scripts.translation: 關於艾音布羅克

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Pardon me?
I don't hear that
request often, but
I suppose it couldn't
do any harm to pose
for just one picture.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
啊？
這種請求倒是少見，不過擺個姿勢拍一張，也沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
茄子~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
You know, it's hard to
believe that Einbroch has
become a major industrial
so quickly. I guess it's the
result of the demand for the
ores mined over in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
真難以置信，艾音布羅克這麼快就成了工業重鎮。我想這要歸功於人們對艾音貝赫礦石的需求。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Although Einbech and Einbroch
can't survive without each other, Einbech is in a pretty sorry state
compared to Einbroch. If you've
ever been there, you know what
I mean. It's almost tragic.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
雖然艾音貝赫和艾音布羅克誰也離不開誰，但和艾音布羅克相比，艾音貝赫的狀況相當糟糕。
如果你去過那裡，你就明白我的意思了。
簡直有點令人悲哀。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Most of the prosperity of
this city is attributed to the
productivity of the factories.
But along with great wealth,
these factories have also
brought pollution problems.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
這座城市的繁榮主要歸功於工廠的高生產力。
但伴隨著巨大的財富，這些工廠也帶來了汙染問題。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
If you hear the
Smog Alert, you should
run to safety as quickly
as you can! It's dangerous
to be out in the open when
the pollution levels are high!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
如果你聽到煙霧警報，應該儘快跑到安全的地方！
在汙染水平高的時候待在戶外是很危險的！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well then, I hope
that you enjoy your
travels here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
那麼，希望你在艾音布羅克的旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Have a good time in
Einbroch, adventurer.
I hope you enjoy your
travels here in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
祝你在艾音布羅克玩得開心，冒險者。
希望你在修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的旅行愉快。
